handback.summary: The audit no longer flags checks the repo added, and runs without a board, skipping board reads and marks.

criteria.858.1: `compare_rule` in `dokima/audit.py` drops the line for required checks Dokima does not declare.
criteria.858.2: `main` no longer exits 1 on an empty or unset `DOKIMA_BOARD`; it runs with `has_board=False`.
criteria.858.3: `check` reads board fields and views only when `has_board`; `run` marks Needs you only then.
criteria.858.4: `compare_rule` still lists each needed check the rule lacks, board or not.
